name: 16402-multiimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. Not gated; 16 GB, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1. Single-GPU is part of the declaration; do not shard it.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, no quantization_config. 28 language layers, 28 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 3584; vision tower 32 layers, patch_size 14, spatial_merge_size 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=5, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm over the OpenAI-compatible chat route, ONE turn: ten distinct 1280x720 JPEGs plus 100 tokens of text in, 3 tokens out. Built as eleven data sources -- one synthetic_text and ten synthetic_image at seeds 101-110, each with images_per_request 1 -- which is what makes one turn carrying ten image parts.
purpose: A vision assistant classifying ten-photo batches with brief answers for five concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the reader, so any structured
# value has to stay on one line. host / port / served-model-name are the serving layer's.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
